task: P6-B-R1 Finite-Precision-Faithful Prediction Preservation Repair and Full CIFAR-10-C Safety Re-run

frozen_configuration.gradient_target: predicted-class decision margin; original-view class fixed across views

prediction_contract.pred_base: historical/regenerated frozen base-classifier prediction from the original float32 inference path
prediction_contract.pred_alpha_numeric: argmax of Orbit-GOP calibrated alpha in the frozen float64 scoring path; QA diagnostic only
prediction_contract.classification_and_correctness: all accuracy, correctness, selective prediction, error-detection AUROC, and AURC calculations use pred_base
prediction_contract.scientific_identity: positive scalar evidence scaling preserves real-valued evidence ordering; calibrated alpha is used only for uncertainty/probability scoring and does not redefine the classifier decision

statistics.synchronization: same sampled base indices retain clean, all 75 conditions, both methods, and all three seeds
statistics.overall_metric: pool 75 equally sized conditions within seed, compute metric per seed, then arithmetic mean over frozen seeds

interpretation_rules_frozen_before_resul.PASS: operational prediction identity; pooled Delta AURC <= 0; pooled Delta Error-AUROC >= 0; at least half of 225 seed-condition cells jointly favorable; overall and mild(severity1-2) Delta_G > 0; no broad mild indiscriminate boundary
interpretation_rules_frozen_before_resul.MIXED: operational prediction identity holds, but one or more PASS requirements fail without meeting FAIL
interpretation_rules_frozen_before_resul.FAIL: operational prediction identity breaks, or pooled Delta AURC > 0 and Delta Error-AUROC < 0 with a majority of seed-condition cells jointly unfavorable, or overall Delta_G <= 0 with stable-correct response at least newly-wrong in both mild severities
interpretation_rules_frozen_before_resul.broad_mild_indiscriminate_boundary: both mild severities have Delta_G <= 0 and, within each, mean Orbit delta uncertainty on stable-correct is >= newly-wrong

hard_failure_conditions: frozen base prediction cannot reproduce historical authority
Orbit-GOP uncertainty formula differs from frozen formal formula
non_failure_diagnostic: pred_alpha_numeric != pred_base is retained and reported but does not stop scientific execution
